description: Curated API ↔ tier ↔ policy ↔ nav fixtures (Batch F improvement #16). Registry is authoritative; fixtures catch doc/marketing drift.

fixtures.label: Pilot — reviews entry
fixtures.trial_limit_behavior: Pilot review entry remains trial-safe; run/seat/expiry limits are surfaced through trial status rather than commercial tier gating.

fixtures.label: Operate analysis — ask
fixtures.trial_limit_behavior: Operate Ask remains a paid-tier surface; trial tenants should see progressive disclosure rather than unrestricted capability promises.

fixtures.label: Operate governance — policy packs
fixtures.trial_limit_behavior: Policy-pack visibility is progressive; trial limits do not override the Standard minimum tier.

fixtures.label: Operate governance — dashboard
fixtures.trial_limit_behavior: Governance workflow access is checked separately from trial run counters and authority.

fixtures.label: Operate alerts — inbox
fixtures.trial_limit_behavior: Alerts are an Operate capability; trial UX should not expose hidden alerting capability names to sub-tier tenants.

fixtures.label: Operate analysis — manifests
fixtures.trial_limit_behavior: Manifest access is tied to governance packaging; trial usage counters stay separate from export availability.
fixtures.notes: Enterprise CSV export tier gate is action-scoped on AuditController.ExportAudit, not class-level.
